_note: Date each army's research is current to: the newest date the last returned report covered. Set by Recce when a report is loaded (or the monthly sweep is merged). tools/mass_prompt.mjs asks for changes after this date (never a window shorter than one month). First pass set to 1 May 2026, the start of the period the app's Developments cover, because the original research was general rather than dated.

_groups._note: Update prompts are built per region, at most 5 armies each. Add a new army to its region; a region with more than 5 is split automatically. Armies not listed here go into an 'Other armies' prompt.
